paragraphs: Ben Zakkai. See Chullin 52a: Ulla said, “Ben Zakkai said.” Rashi explains that we do not know who Ben Zakkai is. Yuchasin, under ayin, wrote Ulla ben Zakkai, understanding Ulla to be Ben Zakkai; he erred, for Ulla reported Ben Zakkai. Rashi therefore wrote that Ben Zakkai, whom Ulla reports, is unidentified (see there).
